Commentary of Ibn Sa'di (Taysir al-Karim al-Rahman) on surah 74, verse 11–31:

{11 – 30} These verses were revealed concerning al-Walid ibn al-Mughira, who opposed the truth and openly waged war and hostility against Allah and His Messenger. Allah censured him with a censure He did not direct at anyone else, and this is the recompense of everyone who opposes the truth and rejects it: for him is disgrace in this world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is even more disgraceful. So He said: {Leave Me with the one whom I created alone}; that is, I created him solitary, without wealth, without family, or anything else. Then I continued to nurture him and give to him, and {I granted him abundant wealth}; that is, much. {And sons who are ever present}; that is, male children present with him constantly, whom he enjoys, through whom he fulfils his needs and seeks help. {And I made preparations for him, making (his life) smooth}; that is, I enabled him to attain the world and its means, until his demands were fulfilled and he obtained whatever he desired and wanted. {Yet he desires that I should give more}; that is, he hopes to attain the bliss of the Hereafter as he attained the bliss of this world, {No!}; that is, the matter is not as he hopes; rather it is contrary to his aim and his objective. That is because {indeed, he was stubborn toward Our verses}: he recognised them and then denied them.
